[[File:Needle detail.png|left|130px]]
A '''Needle''' is an item used along with [[thread]] to create armour out of [[leather]] and dragon leather through the [[Crafting]] skill. It can be bought in crafting stores, such as [[Dommik's Crafting Store.|Dommik's Crafting Store]] in Al Kharid. They can also be bought from [[Moon Clan Fine Clothes]] on [[Lunar Isle]], the Canifis General Store and [[Fancy Clothes Store]] in [[Varrock]] (Members). After completion of [[Death on the Isle]], a [[Costume needle]] can be used for crafting without needing thread.

Needles can also be found from digging in the [[Digsite]]. They can also be found with a 10% probability by searching [[haystack]]s or hay bales - this is a reference to the idiom "[[wiktionary:needle in a haystack|finding a needle in a haystack]]", meaning something that is almost impossible to find because it is hidden among so many other things. When your character finds one this way, they will remark on how rare an occurrence it is.

Needles are stackable items, presumably because they are small,<ref>{{PlainCiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1019871289526439936|quote=I guess whoever made them figured they were really small, and decided to let them stack.|date=19 July 2018|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200430115000/https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1019871289526439936|archivedate=30 April 2020}}</ref> although normal usage does not require them to be.

During the [[Witch's House]] quest, a needle can be found by searching the crates in the basement.
